SUMMARY
Conveniently located in the popular Mount Pleasant area of Swansea, this traditional linked detached property offers spacious accommodation across two floors and is being sold with tenants in situ until July 2027. Benefiting from areception rooms, a downstairs WC and three bedrooms.

DESCRIPTION
Situated in the sought-after Mount Pleasant area of Swansea (SA1 6EQ), this two-bedroom linked-detached property is offered for sale with tenants in situ, contracted until July 2027, making it an attractive investment opportunity.

The ground floor comprises an entrance hallway leading to one reception room and one downstairs bedroom, providing flexible living and dining space. To the rear of the property is a fitted kitchen along with the added convenience of a downstairs WC.

 On the first floor, there are two bedrooms and a family shower room. 

The property benefits from on-street parking and enjoys a convenient location within easy reach of Swansea city centre, local amenities, transport links and Swansea University.

While offering excellent potential, the property would benefit from a programme of modernisation, providing purchasers with the opportunity to enhance and add value over time. With a long-term tenancy already in place, this property is ideally suited to investors seeking an immediate rental income with future scope for improvement.
